label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: logs COMPLETE, timings COMPLETE, handler max 910.11 ms, failures 0

A.rule: throughput shortfall without a slow consumer component

report.summary: Outbox publications fell below arrivals from about 18:06:20, so a backlog built up. A slow consumer handler (~910 ms on some deliveries) is the likely cause. Sequential polling as the mechanism is not confirmed.

findings.claim: Publication throughput dropped to about 9-10 per 10 s while arrivals continued at 22 per 10 s, so the pending backlog grew.
findings.reason: Per-bucket publications fell from 38 to 8-11 while arrivals held at 22; pending rose from 2 to 199 and the oldest age exceeded 1600 s.

findings.claim: The delay sits in the consumer handler, not in LedgerCore auth, the network or the DB. Handler p95 is 910 ms versus a 0.027 ms p50.
findings.reason: Total p95 is 982 ms, nearly all of it handler time. Auth is about 70 ms and unattributed time is under 2 ms.

findings.claim: The slow handler caps drain throughput below the arrival rate. The roughly 1 s per delivery implied by about 10 per 10 s is consistent with a sequential poll loop, so the backlog grows.
findings.reason: The drain rate matches roughly 1 s per delivery. Batch size is 20 and the timeout is 3000 ms, but sequential delivery is not directly observed.

limitations: The consumer is a test fixture, so the handler slowness may not reflect production behaviour.
The cause of the 138 pre-existing FAILED rows and the earlier backlog (oldest age 1385 s at window start) is outside the window.
next_checks: Check whether the outbox poller delivers a batch sequentially or in parallel, and whether handler latency changed at about 18:06:20.
Inspect why the 138 rows are FAILED and whether they should be retried.

alternatives.reason: There were no pool acquisition timeouts, no pending borrowers and no blocking sessions.
alternatives.hypothesis: DB pool exhaustion or lock contention slowed publishing.

alternatives.reason: All 500 attempts succeeded. The 138 FAILED rows were flat throughout the window, so they predate it and did not grow.
alternatives.hypothesis: Delivery failures and retries caused the backlog.
